segment_captions.caption: The Great Missouri Train Robbery title card appears over the group of men holding guns.
The title card 'The Great Missouri Train Robbery 1874' appears on screen, with a silhouette of a man in the foreground.
A silhouette of a cowboy riding a horse against a sunset backdrop with cacti and birds flying overhead.
C rides a horse in a desert landscape with cacti and a sunset sky. The horse rears up slightly, and birds fly in the background.
C rides a horse in a desert landscape during sunset, with cacti and rocks silhouetted against the colorful sky. The horse rears up slightly, and birds fly in the background.
A hand holding a revolver points towards a building in a town setting. The background shows a clear sky with no visible movement of the gun or the hand.
C points a revolver at a fallen figure in the foreground while standing in a town square with other people watching in the background.
C walks past a fallen figure, then stands outside a bank holding money bags and a dollar sign.
C holds two money bags and smiles, then walks into a cornfield holding two pistols.

A man in a top hat and suit raises his arms in a room filled with people, including a woman in a white dress and a man in a black coat. A large camera is positioned in front of them, capturing the scene.
A man on horseback aims a gun while another man in a cowboy hat rides alongside him, both in front of a bank building.
A wanted poster featuring two men is displayed, highlighting their faces against a dark background.
A wanted poster featuring two men in suits and hats is displayed. The text 'WANTED' is prominently shown above their images, followed by 'JESSE AND FRANK JAMES' below.
The text 'JESSE AND FRANK JAMES' appears below the image of two men in hats and suits, with the words 'DEAD OR ALIVE' partially visible beneath it.
C walks towards a train derailment scene with another person observing from behind.
C and another person observe two trains that have collided head-on, with debris scattered around them. The scene is set outdoors with trees in the background.
C hands money to another person while standing outdoors near a train wreck.
C holds a stack of money in his left hand while A holds a stack of money in his right hand. Both men are smiling and appear to be discussing the money they are holding.

C rides a horse, holding a money bag in his left hand while wearing a hat and formal attire. Another person in a black hat and coat rides alongside him, also holding a money bag. The background shows a green landscape with trees.
A train travels along a track with smoke emitting from its engine, passing through a rural landscape with trees and grass in the foreground.

A train moves along a track with passengers seated inside. The scene transitions to the interior of a train car where people are sitting, some holding weapons. A man in a top hat is prominently featured, holding a gun.

A man in a hat and scarf aims a gun towards another man holding a revolver. The man with the gun appears to be in motion, possibly walking or leaning forward. The other man remains seated, holding his revolver steady. The background shows a train interior with passengers seated and standing.

A man in a green coat and hat holds a gun, standing next to others in a row, each holding a weapon. The background shows a desert landscape with cacti and a tent. The men appear to be preparing for a confrontation or standoff.

A man in a black hat and white shirt rides a horse, holding the reins with his right hand while wearing a face mask. Another man in a gray coat and brown vest sits behind him, also wearing a face mask and holding onto the horse's saddle. The background shows a grassy field with a tree and a clear sky.
C rides a horse, holding the reins with both hands. The horse moves forward steadily.

C rides a horse, wearing a face mask and a hat, while another person in a black coat and hat sits behind him. The scene transitions to a sign reading 'GADS HILL MISSOURI' in front of a grassy field with trees in the background.
A wooden signpost with 'GADS HILL MISSOURI' written on it remains stationary against a backdrop of grass and trees under a clear sky.
A sign reading 'GADS HILL MISSOURI' is shown, then the scene transitions to a village with people walking and a windmill in the background.

A man in a hat walks towards a group of people standing near a wagon and a building labeled 'STOKE'. The scene is set in a rural area with a windmill and houses in the background. The sky is orange, suggesting it might be sunset.
C walks towards a group of people in a rural setting, passing by a store and a windmill. The scene depicts a peaceful village atmosphere with various buildings and a cart in the foreground.

C walks through a town square, passing by a store and other buildings under a setting sun. A windmill stands prominently in the background. The scene captures a peaceful rural evening with people engaged in various activities.
C walks past a group of people near a store building.
A train travels along a track with smoke emitting from its engine, passing through a rural landscape with trees and hills under a clear sky.
A train moves along a track, emitting smoke. The scene transitions to a group of people seated in what appears to be a theater or auditorium, watching a performance.
A man in a top hat adjusts his bow tie while seated in a theater. The audience remains still, watching the stage.
A large safe with a combination lock is shown. The door is closed and there are no visible changes in the environment or object states.
A train travels along a track with smoke emitting from its chimney, passing through a rural landscape with trees and grass in the foreground.
A steam locomotive pulls a series of passenger cars along a track under a clear sky. The train moves steadily from left to right, leaving behind a trail of smoke.
A train moves along a track with a landscape of trees and hills in the background. The camera then cuts to a close-up of a man's face, showing him looking to the side with a calm expression.
A train travels through a scenic landscape with trees and hills under a clear sky.
A train passes through a forested landscape with a fire burning nearby. A man in a hat and coat stands beside the fire, observing it.
C stands near a bush as a fire burns in the foreground. Another person in a hat is also present nearby.
A man holds a red flag signaling a train approaching on the tracks.
A train approaches on the tracks while a person holds a red flag, signaling its presence.

A man in a hat points a revolver at another man wearing a cap and vest, who stands passively with his hands behind his back. The revolver's barrel is clearly visible, aimed directly at the other man's chest.
C opens a safe revealing stacks of money and gold bars inside.
C opens the safe revealing stacks of cash and scattered gold coins inside.
A document titled 'INVENTORY' is shown, listing 'Robbed at Gad's Hill'.
The camera focuses on a piece of paper titled 'INVENTORY' with the subtitle 'Robbed at Gads Hill'. The text is written in cursive font.

A group of people dressed in historical attire are seated on a train. One individual in the foreground holds a gun, while others appear to be engaged in conversation or looking around. The setting suggests a historical reenactment or a themed event.
A man in a green coat and red bandana sits next to another man in a top hat. The man in the green coat looks around the train car, while the other man remains seated.
A character wearing a hat and scarf sits next to another character in a top hat. The scene shifts to show a third character with white hair and a blue dress, seated behind the first two characters.
C's hand is shown in close-up, palm facing down against a beige background.
C adjusts their hat with both hands.
C adjusts his tie while looking around the room.
C picks up a revolver from his side, holding it with both hands, preparing to draw it.
C holds a revolver, then lowers it and looks around cautiously.

C reads a newspaper article about a train robbery, focusing on the text about the robbers' purpose of robbing Mr. Stanchfield, Secretary of the Clearwater Lumber Company, who was expected to be on the train with $7,000 but was not aboard.
The text on the screen changes from a detailed account of a train robbery to a headline about a train robbery at Gads Hill, indicating a shift in focus to a summary or conclusion of the incident.

A masked man in a top hat and suit holds a revolver, pointing it forward with his right hand while his left hand rests on his hip. The background is a simple, muted color palette with no additional details.
A hand holds a piece of paper labeled 'Press release' against a green background.
C holds a piece of paper labeled 'Press release' and reads it aloud. The text on the paper reads: 'There's a hell of an excitement in this part of the country.'
A group of men wearing hats and bandanas stand together, each holding a rifle. The scene appears tense, suggesting a moment of anticipation or confrontation.

A man in a green coat and brown pants holds money while standing next to a seated man in a gray suit holding a brown bag. Behind them, two men in black suits and hats stand with money scattered on the ground. Another man in a red coat and black hat stands further back, holding a gun. The scene appears to depict a robbery or theft scenario.

A man in a brown coat and hat holds money while standing next to a campfire. Another man in a gray suit sits nearby, holding a small bag. A third man in a red jacket stands behind them, smiling. The scene appears to be set in a tented area with other men in period clothing standing around.
A man in a brown suit sits on the ground, holding stacks of money. A pile of coins and a watch are on a table nearby. A clock shows the time.
$5,000 appears above the stacks of money on the desk.
C picks up a bundle of $5,000 bills from the desk, revealing more stacks underneath.

A group of men dressed in period attire stand around a table filled with stacks of money and coins. One man holds a bundle of money while others look on. The scene suggests a moment of transaction or distribution of wealth.

A man in a brown suit sits on the ground, holding money in both hands. Another man in a gray suit stands nearby, also holding money. A third man in a red coat and black hat stands behind them, smiling. The scene appears to be outdoors, with a tent and some scattered money on the ground.
The group of men stands around, some holding money, while one man sits on the ground with a bag beside him. The scene remains static with no significant changes in their positions or the environment.
